children: Consumer discretionary stocks have faced a mixed performance in 2026 as shifting consumer demand, elevated borrowing costs and persistent price pressures have weighed on parts of the sector, even as spending has remained resilient in some areas.

Automakers, retailers, restaurants and other discretionary businesses have also been navigating uneven demand and changing consumer preferences, while higher financing costs continue to affect big-ticket purchases.
Against this backdrop, a quantitative screen identifies four consumer discretionary stocks that have maintained a Sell or Strong Sell Quant Rating for at least 60 consecutive days.
The list is topped by Lucid Group
, which has maintained a Strong Sell Quant Rating for 382 consecutive days. EVgo
follows with 199 consecutive days, while Whirlpool Corporation
has held its Strong Sell rating for 129 days. Serve Robotics
rounds out the list with 65 consecutive days at a Strong Sell rating.

Seeking Alpha's Quant Ratings system grades stocks on their relative performance on key quantitative metrics. It hones in on stocks with the strongest combination of value, growth, profitability, EPS revisions and price momentum relative to their sector peers.
